zh: 我參加 Garmin Run 是因為...
en: I am joining Garmin Run because

zh: 跑者大拜拜之一，必須搶！
en: A big gathering for runners — I have to get a spot!
If a race sounds fun, I sign up!

zh: 目標賽事之一，11月底是突破PB的好時機！
en: It is a target race; late November is a great time for a PB!

zh: 從5月報名到今天比賽前…
en: From signing up in May to race day…

zh: 不分賽季，平常都一直在跑啦
en: I run all year, whatever the season.
A full serving of training every day.
Packing my gear the night before the race

zh: 儀式感要有，裝備排好來張大合照！
en: Lay out the gear for a group photo — it is part of the ritual!

zh: 該帶的塞進衣保袋、晶片綁好，睡飽比較重要啦
en: Pack the bag, attach the chip, and get a good night’s sleep.

zh: 鞋子、手錶、果膠…必須萬無一失！
en: Shoes, watch, gels… everything has to be ready!

zh: 看準空檔，精準進站！遠離人群！
en: Find a gap and make a precise stop, away from the crowd!

zh: 終於可以休息！ 看看有什麼好吃的?
en: Finally, a break! What is there to eat?

zh: 優雅地拿出自己的軟水杯／軟水壺裝水
en: Take out my own soft cup or flask and fill up with ease.
Get ready! I want to arrive in style.

zh: All in了！現在不衝什麼時候衝！
en: All in! If not now, when?

slogan_zh: 跑的是賽事，收的是回憶！
slogan_en: Run the race, collect the memories!

slogan_zh: 跑步是生活，比賽是日常！
slogan_en: Running is life; racing is part of the everyday!

slogan_zh: 追逐PB是我跑下去的動力！
slogan_en: Chasing a PB keeps me running!
tag4_zh: 補站抓水杯要嚴格練習

description_zh: 不用跟人擠，想喝就喝，還能外帶點食物
description_en: Skip the crowd, drink when you want, and carry a snack.

description_zh: 用自己的杯子，慢慢休我就Chill~~
description_en: Use your own cup and take a chilled-out break.

zh: 懂玩! 你已經帶上自己補水裝備
en: You know how to enjoy a race — you already bring your own hydration gear!
description_zh: 也邀請身邊的跑友一起試試不同的補水方式
description_en: Invite your running friends to try a different way to hydrate too.

description_zh: 不用跟人擠，想補就補維持自己節奏
description_en: Skip the crowd and hydrate to your own rhythm.

description_zh: 輕到沒有存在感，還能在水站休一下
description_en: So light you barely notice it, with time for a water-station break.

zh: 不愧是專業跑者，不忘帶上自己補水裝備
en: A dedicated runner who remembers their own hydration gear!
description_zh: 也邀請身邊的跑友一起試試不同的補水方式
description_en: Invite your running friends to try a different way to hydrate too.

description_zh: 偶爾也可以喘口氣，以不同的方式體驗賽道
description_en: Take a breath sometimes and experience the course a different way.

description_zh: 該休還是要休一下，帶著輕到沒有存在感
description_en: Take a break when you need one, with a cup you barely notice.

zh: 神人級! 這樣速還帶上自己補水裝備!
en: Impressive! That fast, and still bringing your own hydration gear!
description_zh: 也邀請身邊的跑友一起試試不同的補水方式
description_en: Invite your running friends to try a different way to hydrate too.

zh: DEMO MODE｜測試資料，不會正式登記抽獎
en: DEMO MODE | Test data; not an official raffle entry

zh: 完成測驗，還有機會抽 Forerunner 170！
en: Finish the quiz for a chance to win a Forerunner 170!

zh: 想參加賽後抽獎嗎？留下姓名與電子郵件即可登記。不參加也能繼續領取現場獎品。
en: Want to enter the post-race raffle? Leave your name and email. You can still collect an on-site prize without entering.
I want to enter the post-race raffle

zh: ［待核准個資告知文字］僅供正式法務核准前的介面占位，不代表 Garmin 已核准蒐集或使用方式。
en: [Privacy notice pending approval] This is an interface placeholder only and is not an approved Garmin collection notice.

zh: 我已閱讀並確認上述個資告知
en: I have read and acknowledged the privacy notice above

zh: 謝謝你已經開始自帶補水！
en: Thank you for already bringing your own hydration!

zh: 自帶補水已經是你的跑步選擇。邀請你繼續保持，也和身邊的跑友分享這種補水方式。
en: Bringing your own hydration is already part of your running routine. Keep it going and share the choice with your running friends.

zh: 下一場跑步，你願意試試自帶補水裝備嗎？
en: For your next run, would you try bringing your own hydration gear?

zh: 從軟水杯、軟水壺或其他適合自己的裝備開始，讓補水方式多一個選擇。
en: Start with a soft cup, soft flask, or another option that suits you and keep hydration flexible.

zh: 我願意加入永續先鋒行動
en: I want to join the hydration action

zh: 下一次跑步，我願意嘗試自帶補水裝備。
en: Next time I run, I will try bringing my own hydration gear.

zh: 先認識不同的補水方式，再找適合自己的選擇。
en: Learn about different hydration options before choosing what fits me.

zh: 請至攤位找工作人員領取 Garmin 周邊
en: Please visit the booth to collect Garmin merchandise from a staff member

zh: GARMIN RUN 跑者風格測驗
重溫Garmin Run找到你的跑者風格！
en: Rediscover Garmin Run and find your running style!

zh: 邀請你與我們一起自帶補水裝備
en: Join us in bringing your own hydration gear
A commitment to try bringing hydration gear next time, not a running-club membership.
I will give it some thought!

zh: 謝謝你已經開始自帶補水！
en: Thank you for already bringing your own hydration!

zh: 請先選擇加入或考慮，再繼續領獎。
en: Choose to join or consider the action before continuing.

zh: 填寫聯絡資訊，參加Forerunner 170抽獎~
en: Your contact details, then your gift

zh: ［未核准・僅供測試］正式個資告知尚待 Garmin 核准。本頁只供測試姓名、Email、領獎與全員抽獎流程；請勿填寫真實個資。此占位文字不是正式告知、政策或抽獎辦法。
en: [UNAPPROVED · TEST ONLY] The formal privacy notice awaits Garmin approval. This page tests contact, gift and automatic raffle registration. Do not enter real personal data. This placeholder is not an official notice, policy or raffle terms.

zh: 我已閱讀測試告知，並確認填寫的是虛構測試資料。
en: I have read the test notice and confirm I am entering fictional test data.

zh: DEMO ONLY｜僅限虛構姓名及 example.com／.test 等測試 Email，會寫入共用 Demo 測試表。
en: DEMO ONLY | Use fictional names and example.com / .test test emails. Entries go to the shared Demo sheets.

zh: 請填寫姓名（最多 80 字）。
請填寫有效的 Email（最多 254 字）。
en: Enter a valid email (up to 254 characters).

zh: 請先確認測試個資告知。
en: Acknowledge the test privacy notice first.

zh: Demo 請使用 example.com、example.org、example.net、.test 或 .invalid 測試信箱。
en: For Demo, use an example.com, example.org, example.net, .test or .invalid email.

zh: 提交失敗，請保留本頁並重試；同一提交不會重複扣庫存。
en: Submission failed. Keep this page and retry with the same request ID.

en: The Demo backend is not V2 yet. Update Apps Script following the deployment guide.

Garmin Run 跑者風格與補水方式互動測驗

en: Uses browser-local test data only. It does not connect to or modify Google Sheets.

en: Stock must be a non-negative integer

Confirm and collect your on-site gift

zh: 謝謝你一起響應自帶補水行動｜另可領取永續行動貼紙與飄帶
en: Thank you for supporting reusable hydration | You may also receive a sustainability sticker and ribbon

en: Please visit the booth to collect Garmin merchandise from a staff member

en: Could not create result image. Please retake the quiz.
